dialogue_texts: Ritsuu
To force your way through my parallel axes with such overwhelming, eternal light...
Ritsuu
It seems the legends of the Moon's immortal empress weren't exaggerated.
Kaguya
Fufufu, your mirror-world structures are quite lovely...
Kaguya
But even a labyrinth of endless paths must eventually bow before the passing of eternity.
Kaguya
Now, won't you tell us why you've tangled the coordinates of this estate?
Hiroyuki
The structural inversion wasn't done out of malice, was it?
Hiroyuki
You've been trying to hold this manor in place while it drifts through parallel timelines.
Ritsuu
If I hadn't deployed those inversion charms to seal the inner grounds...
Ritsuu
The overlapping dimensions would have crushed everything before the core could stabilize.
Ritsuu
But your raw power has completely shattered my boundaries.
Kaguya
Then the path to the very heart of this little storm is wide open.
Kaguya
It would be dreadfully boring to turn back now, wouldn't you say, Shirogane-sama?
Hiroyuki
I have no intention of turning back.
Hiroyuki
If the temporal anomaly is deep enough to warp reality this heavily, we need to secure the core immediately.
